name: What can go wrong when a general contractor manages a project poorly?
description: Common problems are delays, cost overruns, weak communication, and quality issues from poor supervision.

mainEntity.name: What can go wrong when a general contractor manages a project poorly?

acceptedAnswer.text: The biggest risks are poor communication, missed milestones, change orders that are not approved in writing, and subcontractor delays. A safer process includes job-site supervision, clear documentation, quality checks, and regular schedule re-evaluation.
